name: igv-reports
description: Cohort-aware driver + post-render verifiers on top of the IGV team's igv-reports (create_report). Builds one self-contained HTML per sample with embedded BAM/VCF slices and default annotation tracks (CpG islands, gencode, RepeatMasker); verifies structure, cross-sample contamination, and (opt-in) read-count anchors. Includes ONT 5mC/5hmC methylation viewer presets.
